arche.title: Arche Industries
arche.visible: Log in Overview Smith DFM Scrapyard Build Design for Smith writes the CAD and runs the simulation. Scrapyard ships the part. One platform from requirements to your doorstep. Try Smith now scroll ↓ How Smith works The distance between requirements and object, collapsed. 01 Describe You describe the part in natural language and annotate the geometry the way you would sketch on a napkin. The agent writes the CAD, with Python as the source of truth. Session: cooling jacket Wrap a copper cooling jacket around the engine liner. Add an inlet port and bolt it down at the top. On it — I'll build the jacket around the liner, add the inlet port and bolt holes, and mark the inlet face so we can pressure-test it next. # build the jacket from your description jacket = revolve(liner_profile, Axis.Z) jacket += inlet_port jacket -= bolt_holes tag(inlet_face, "inlet" ) 02 Simulate Suggest a load case and Smith simulates it in real time. GPU-accelerated structural and CFD analysis run while the design takes shape. Analysis: coolant proof pressure 4 MPa 0 MPA 62 MPA PEAK VON MISES 98.4 MPA MAX DISPLACEMENT 0.07 MM FACTOR OF SAFETY 0.7 03 Build real Fasteners and hardware come from live supplier catalogs, never unnecessarily built from scratch. When it's right, publish an immutable version, with geometry you can actually order. Parts library M8 socket head, A286 93395A118 M8 × 1.25, 30 mm socket head, A286 superalloy IN STOCK 98956A103 M8 copper sealing washer IN STOCK 91290A150 M8 × 1.25 hex nut, A286 superalloy IN STOCK 50785K213 AN6 37° flare inlet fitting, 316 SS 2-DAY 9464K37 Viton O-ring, 12 mm ID × 2 mm IN STOCK 5239K64 PTFE-lined coolant hose, −6 AN 3-DAY DFM mode Designed for the machine that makes it. Flip Smith into DFM mode and every part is shaped by how it will actually be made. For 3D printing, the orientation solver ranks twenty candidate build directions and checks overhangs, bridging, minimum walls, and build-volume fit, with every check a pass, warn, or fail. For sheet metal, Smith computes the flat pattern and the bend table with per-material K-factors, and exports a layered DXF ready for the laser, the waterjet, or the press brake. FDM · DFM checks ORIENTATION SOLVER PASS OVERHANGS > 45° PASS MIN WALL 0.8 MM WARN BUILD VOLUME PASS Scrapyard Closes the loop between the part you modeled and the part that ships to your doorstep. Scrapyard is the marketplace and discovery layer wrapped around Smith. Every published part is an immutable snapshot with a live 3D preview. Browse what's trending, praise what's good, and remix anything: deep-clone a design into your own project and keep editing. The parts are real components from real supplier catalogs, so every object becomes a base file anyone can fork, customize, and reorder. SMITH Compact ball valve, ½ in.
